blocks.text: Material bodies (maadi cheezein) ki sab motions (chalne ki qismon) mein circular motion (daire mein chalna) nature mein sab se zyada nazar aati hai. Zameen ke gird circular orbits mein ghoomte satellites, khud Zameen ki orbital motion aur spin motion (apne axis par ghoomna), mor par murti car, aur dori se ghumaya gaya patthar iski aam misalein hain. Jab cheezein daire mein chalti hain to un ki direction (rukh) lagatar badalti rehti hai. Velocity vector quantity hai, is liye direction badalne ka matlab hai ke velocity constant nahi rehti.
Is chapter mein hum circular motion, rotational motion (apne axis par ghoomna), moment of inertia, angular momentum aur in se related topics parhenge.

Daire ke centre (beech ka point) O par arc (daire ka tukra) AB se banne wala angle lein (Fig. 3.1). Agar arc AB ki lambai daire ke radius r ke barabar ho to centre par banne wala angle ek radian kehlata hai. Radian angle napne ka SI unit hai aur is ka symbol “rad” hai.

blocks.alt: Centre O wala daira. Do radius OA aur OB, dono par r likha hai, ek rangeen sector gherte hain; arc (daire ka tukra) AB ki lambai radius ke barabar hai aur O par angle (kona) 1 rad likha hai. Daire ke bahar mura teer A se B ki taraf jata hai.
